original_test_intent: Verify the approved Independent/default memory operating mode, full expected BIOS/OS capacity and channel enumeration remain correct across DC/warm reboot and an approved memory stress without errors.
original_method: Qualified operator captures and sets the authoritative BIOS mode, captures capacity, executes an approved cold/warm reboot matrix; agent collects complete DMI/OS/topology/health after each boot and runs only the approved bounded stress with interlocks.
manual_activity: Engineer defines the mode/channel/capacity/reboot/stress contract; operator performs BIOS and power actions; agent may collect OS evidence and run approved stress.
required_inputs: Authoritative meaning and BIOS label/value for Independent/default memory mode
Approved DIMM/rank/channel map and expected BIOS installed/available plus OS usable capacity
Qualified operator/KVM, safe BIOS change and DC/warm reboot count/order
Approved stress tool/version/workload/duration and thermal/power/ECC/OOM limits
Protected evidence, known-good restore, recovery and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Require user approval, qualified operator, stable power/cooling and KVM before BIOS/power actions
Capture current settings and known-good recovery before change
Preserve baseline logs and continuously monitor health during reboot/stress
Stop on no-POST, capacity/topology mismatch, ECC/SEL/thermal/power/OOM/watchdog error or instability
No automatic BIOS change, power cycle, retry or recovery
agent_execution_scope: After operator steps, collect complete DMI/OS/NUMA/channel/health evidence after each boot
Run only the signed stress profile with full output and interlocks
Do not infer Independent mode from locators, operate BIOS/power, select missing criteria or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve mode semantics and missing reboot/stress procedure details
Approve topology/capacity, workload, limits and recovery
Review multi-phase evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient and unsafe: filtered DMI cannot prove channel independence and omits BIOS, capacity, DC/warm reboot and stress criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Hybrid operator BIOS/reboot workflow plus secure complete DMI/OS/NUMA/health collection and a separately approved monitored stress command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Independent/default mode, BIOS/OS size, DC/warm reboot, stress and1/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed state-transition matrix: baseline, approved mode, cold boot, warm reboot and stress, with complete topology/capacity/health evidence at each state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing criteria phases, authoritative mode identity, safe state control and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: DMI-only collection omits most of the source acceptance and cannot count.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware names for independent/lockstep/mirror/sparing vary, and DMI locator/rank fields do not prove electrical channel operating mode.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define whether default is actually Independent and how BIOS installed/available and OS usable memory are compared; no reboot count or stress profile is guessed.
expected_evidence: Approval, operator, board/CPU/DIMM/rank/channel/BIOS/firmware and baseline settings
Authoritative BIOS mode page before/after and setting-change record
BIOS/OS capacity and complete DMI/NUMA/channel mapping
DC and warm reboot sequence/timestamps/boot health
Complete stress command/output/metrics and safety telemetry
Baseline/final dmesg/syslog/SEL/ECC/thermal/power plus recovery/invalid-run and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure ends after setting default memory mode and checking size, but Criteria additionally require DC, warm reboot and stress without specifying their sequence, count or workload; Independent versus default mode is also undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mode specification, operator, reboot/stress details and recovery can be supplied; static review is complete and pending decisions do not block later records.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row40 Wistron-Memory-00023-V004: define authoritative Independent/default BIOS memory-mode label and channel semantics, approved DIMM/rank/channel map, BIOS installed/available versus OS usable capacity tolerance, and the Criteria-only DC/warm-reboot count/order plus stress tool/version/workload/duration; approve BIOS/KVM change, health/thermal/power/ECC/OOM abort, baseline-log preservation, restore/recovery and invalid-run policy; filtered dmidecode locators alone must not prove independence.

review_improvement: Restores all Criteria-only reboot/stress coverage and prevents a locator summary from falsely proving an operating mode.
independent_technical_reasoning: Independent channel operation is a firmware/controller policy, not an inference from seeing multiple SMBIOS locators. The BIOS mode must be captured directly and expected capacity computed from the platform map. Because cold boot, warm reset and sustained stress exercise different training and runtime paths, each missing phase needs explicit state, evidence and recovery rather than being silently omitted.
